newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 opens firm after Wall St. recovers.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 opens firm after Wall St. recovers.

text.p: Leading UK shares were marked up at the start on Monday on the back of a rebound on Wall Street.
At 0741 GMT, the FTSE 100 share index was up 19.7 points to 4,256.3, as advancers broadly led decliners 72 to 10.
The Dow, down about seven points when London markets closed on Friday, ended 48.72 points higher at 6,526.07. But for the week, the average lost more than 214 points.
"We we're definately starting to see a two-way pull develop," said the head of sales trading at one major brokerage. "But there are still bargain hunters out there."
